verses.1: The graves, and I have swallowed up their bones.
verses.2: They are not gathered together so that they may rise at the resurrection with their kin, nor are their bones mingled with the bones of the evil, the erring, and the pagan.
verses.3: And if your understanding is not deceived when you say, 'By what means shall the dead rise after their death, those who are cast into the... within?
verses.4: And when you look into the grave, not even a handful of dust is found; by what means, then, shall the bones of the dead rise?' you say this in the hardness of your heart.
verses.5: When what you have sown does not sprout, do you say, 'Will what you have sown sprout?'
verses.6: And likewise God, who sowed souls, will raise them quickly and will not delay their rising, by His life-giving word; for it is He who brought man forth from non-being into being, in truth.
verses.7: And again, from being He brought him into death, and again, from death He will bring him into being.
verses.8: For it is God who gives him life and raises him up.
